summary_1line: After Indrajit reports Rama and Lakshmana incapacitated, Ravana orders Sita to be shown their bodies, hoping despair will force her to submit.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana, seated in triumph in his palace, commands demonesses to show Sita the supposedly fallen Rama and Lakshmana on the battlefield.
Monkey warriors clutching uprooted trees stand in tense circles around the motionless bodies of Rama and Lakshmana, scanning the sky for demons.
The Pushpaka aerial chariot prepares to carry Sita while demonesses gather around her under Ravana’s cruel order.
